comment: Phrases only the native apps say: menu items, window titles and anything else a browser never shows. The web client's own dictionaries are read directly by generate.mjs and are not copied here; a phrase the web already has belongs there, and the generator refuses one that appears in both. Each entry is keyed by its English, exactly as t() is called, and gives all four languages: "en" (normally the key itself), "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant" and "ja". Placeholders are written {likeThis} and must appear unchanged in every language. After editing, run: node apple/i18n/generate.mjs
